label: Dance · Vogue
desc: A runway pose, geometric hands around the face, a dip to the floor and back, a closing frame around the eyes.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, graceful and dynamic motion, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: a dancer in fitted high-fashion attire strikes an angular runway model pose facing the camera
they execute rapid, geometric hand performance and wrist-spinning motions around their head and face
they instantly drop straight down into a dramatic floor dip, resting one leg underneath with arms extended
they push back up to their feet smoothly, maintaining rhythmic upper body isolations
they strike a final fierce pose, framing their eyes tightly with both hands while gazing into the lens
